newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Finance, Citibank in $100 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Finance, Citibank in $100 mln deal.

text.p: Kuwait Finance House (KFH) on Saturday announced a $100 million Islamic loan facility along with Citibank Malaysia (Labuan) Ltd to finance the import of jet fuel and spare parts for Malaysia Airline System Bhd (MAS).
KFH chairman Badr al-Makhizeem said the Kuwaiti financial Islamic institution's share of the facility was for $65 million to be settled over a year, the Kuwait News Agency reported.
The deal is structured under the rules of Murabaha, an Islamic banking method which averts interest payments. Goods are bought with accord with a client then sold to him at a profit.
